text: Free tower defense demo, except you're not defending the kingdom.
An ancient sorcerer behind a magic shield, blasting endless waves of heroes with meteors, lightning and magic guns.
Your undead bodyguards include Scary Potter and Arnold Schwarzenecro.
Best bit in the trailer: a giant golden laser that deletes a whole crowd.
The catch? The animations are stiff, like paper puppets from an old Flash game.
Ten acts, twelve languages on the store page, and the demo is under eight hundred megabytes.
Think Defend Your Castle, if the castle was a warlock.
Worth a dip. Being evil looks fun.
